reviews.text:
Aroa's treatment of our dog is excellent, she is a great professional.
I recommend Peluqueria kom qom to everyone.

Cersei looked fantastic! It was her first visit to a groomer, and the attention and dedication were top-notch! The communication was excellent in every way, especially regarding the cut I wanted for my little puppy! Without a doubt, this is the groomer Cersei will be going to next. The cleaning service was also excellent. Highly recommended for their dedication, kindness, and professionalism.
Excellent service, the girl was very affectionate and kind with my pet...I highly recommend her, she's excellent 👌

Aroa treated my 6 year old- big baby Mastif x with much love and respect. It was the 1st time he has ever enjoyed going to be groomed . !
A great job! .He smells and looks great ! Gracias Aroa. X

I couldn't be happier with this place! They are absolutely wonderful and very professional.

I especially want to highlight Aroa, who is in charge of Nino's grooming and bathing. She is lovely, caring, patient, and extremely careful with him.

I chose this place precisely because Nino is very fearful and has had traumatic experiences with both veterinarians and groomers, so it was essential for me to find someone who knew how to treat him with a lot of patience and sensitivity. I couldn't have found a better place.

It gives me so much peace of mind to leave Nino in Aroa's hands because I know she treats him with love, respect, and great gentleness. I highly recommend it!
We took our very timid dog, and Aroa was incredibly kind to him. She was clearly very patient and caring, and he looked beautiful afterward. We'll definitely be back.
Everything was great! Already booked our second appointment. Highly recommend! 🐶❤️
Aroa is a great professional. You can tell she's passionate about what she does. She treats my dog ​​Star with love and is very patient. The service is quality. I recommend!
So happy with the result 😊 They treated my dog ​​wonderfully and made her look gorgeous. We'll be back! 🐶❤️

I brought in my 6-month-old kitten who had incredibly matted fur, so I decided she needed a haircut and a fresh start. After the haircut and bath, Aroa returned her to me looking perfect (she also cleaned her ears and trimmed her nails). It's clear she puts a lot of care into her work, and she answered all my questions with incredible kindness. I'll definitely return if I need help again.
The attention I received from Aroa was outstanding. She explained the service your pet would receive, and the treatment was excellent. I'm very happy with the result! 👍👍

Very happy with the haircut and the service Aura gave us, we'll definitely be back! 🤗
Thank you so much Aura, see you next time! 🍀 …

I've tried many dog ​​groomers, and honestly, none can compare to this one. They inspire confidence from the very first moment, making you feel comfortable leaving your pet with them, and the results are incredible. Plus, they send you photos and videos of the process. We'll definitely be back, and I highly recommend them!
I loved the way they treated and cared for my dog ​​🥰🥰😍 …

I absolutely loved the result! They treated my cat Pelusa with so much love, patience, and professionalism, something I truly appreciate because working with cats isn't always easy. Aroa, the groomer, did an excellent job, and it's clear she has a lot of experience and loves animals. Pelusa looked gorgeous and was very well cared for the entire time. Brushing, bath, haircut, and lots of pampering with a final touch of perfume 😻
I definitely recommend her 100%. If you're looking for a trustworthy dog ​​and cat groomer, don't hesitate to go to her. We'll be back, thank you!!! 😻
I loved it! I was fascinated! My baby looked beautiful and was so happy 🤎 …

We'll definitely be back! Gofre left absolutely delighted. Aroa, a lovely person who clearly adores furry friends, took care of him. Gofre came out sparkling clean and looking brand new—a truly excellent service. We've found our go-to groomer for our furry friend!

Thank you so much for pampering him so much!

Highly recommended. I have a large dog, and we always run into problems everywhere, or they simply refuse to take him. Here, everything was easy from the very beginning. They made him look gorgeous and clean, and most importantly, you can tell they have patience and care for animals. They've won us over as customers; we'll definitely be back.

Our dog Fido's first time at Kom Qom, and it will definitely be the first of many. We were absolutely delighted with the haircut and spa treatment he received. Aroa was also incredibly loving and attentive. A perfect 10 in every way! Fido looked gorgeous and his fur was so soft. You can tell the products they used were top quality. Thank you!
Great haircut 🤩 I’m so happy, my dog looks and smells so fresh. They were very thorough! Would definitely recommend …
Without a doubt, she's the best hairdresser there is. Aroa is officially our baby's hairdresser.

I couldn't be happier with Aroa's work. She's simply the best groomer we've ever met: she treats our furry friends with so much love, patience, and professionalism.

It's clear she's passionate about what she does and pays meticulous attention to every detail. She follows all our instructions to the letter, completely respects our directions, and achieves exactly the result we want, even surpassing it with her experience.

I wholeheartedly recommend this place. It's definitely a trustworthy place where you know your furry friend is in the best hands. But based on my experience, I always recommend booking an appointment with Aroa before taking them.
Thank you Aroa for everything! Excellent service, I left very happy, and the dog even more so.

Today I took Mia, my black toy poodle, and the experience was excellent. Aroa treated us wonderfully from the very first moment, with so much care, patience, and professionalism. You can tell she loves animals and pays attention to every detail. Mia left looking gorgeous, calm, and happy, which is super important to me. The haircut was perfect, and the service was impeccable. We will definitely be back. Highly recommended!
Excellent service! It was the first time I took my dog ​​to a groomer, and he came out very happy with a great haircut. I highly recommend this place!

Excellent care and attention for my cats. They pamper them and they enjoy their stay, being cared for with so much love that we really appreciate it. Thank you, Aroa, for everything! 🥰 We'll be back! …
Excellent service! I'm very happy with how my dog ​​turned out!

Excellent work! They understood me perfectly and helped me fix the previous groomer's work. The first photo shows my dog ​​before the cut, and the second is after the cut at another salon, where they left his snout very crooked and square, despite the examples of snout cuts I showed them. Then I came here, showed them my examples, and they did everything perfectly, even though my little guy already had a haircut, and in some areas quite short, which complicated the job. But in the end, they achieved the perfect proportions I wanted!

Excellent service at Kom Qom Spa Grooming. Taking a Samoyed like Agatha in is a challenge, but they did a perfect job: bath, haircut, nails, and teeth were impeccable. Everything was great, we'll definitely be back!
I can only say that I fell in love with the service and the way I was treated. I will definitely be back with my dog. Thank you so much, Aroa, for being so attentive! 🙏🏼☺️ …
Excellent service, perfect attention from the first contact. Fiona looked beautiful and was thrilled. They send photos and updates throughout the process. 1000% recommended!

The girls are lovely. Both Aroa, who gave me the appointment and advice, and Gemma, who groomed my dog ​​Olga, left her looking fantastic and incredibly soft 😊. She's an older dog, and when I picked her up, she was so relaxed. You can really see the care they put into their work. Thank you so much, and see you at the next appointment ⭐️
